title: Flow Cytometry Assay for T-Cell Cytotoxicity Against MC38 Cell Line
author: Bulent Arman Aksoy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.83bhyin
materials: Supplement T cells with 200 IU/mL rIL2

steps.title: Collect and resuspend MC38 cells
steps.instruction: Collect at least 3 × 10⁶ MC38 cells by trypsinizing from an ongoing culture, spin at 200 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in fresh media at 2.5 × 10⁵ cells/mL.

steps.title: Seed MC38 cells in 24‑well plate
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of the MC38 suspension (≈125 000 cells) to each well of a 24‑well plate and incubate overnight to allow adherence.

steps.title: Prepare cytotoxic T cells
steps.instruction: Collect 2 × 10⁶ cytotoxic T cells per sample from an ongoing culture, spin at 350 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend in fresh media at 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL.

steps.title: Add T cells to MC38 wells
steps.instruction: Aspirate as much culture medium as possible from each MC38‑containing well without disturbing adherent cells, then add 2 mL of the T‑cell suspension to each well (giving an 8:1 T‑cell:MC38 ratio assuming MC38 doubled overnight).

steps.title: Co‑culture incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the co‑culture for at least 16 h (overnight) before proceeding to assay.

steps.title: Harvest co‑culture into tubes
steps.instruction: Label a 2 mL Eppendorf tube for each well, pipette the entire well content up and down with a P1000, and transfer it to the corresponding tube.

steps.title: Trypsinize harvested cells
steps.instruction: Within 2 min of aspiration, add 200 µL of 0.05 % 1X Trypsin (VWR International, Avantor, Cat# 16777‑202) to each well, incubate at room temperature for 2 min.

steps.title: Neutralize trypsin and collect cells
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL of culture media to each well to stop trypsinization, then spin the tubes at 350 × g for 5 min, aspirate 1 mL of supernatant without disturbing the pellet, transfer the remaining 1 mL of trypsinized cells to a new tube, spin again at 350 × g for 5 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet for staining
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL flow buffer, then add 5 µL each of PerCP anti‑mouse CD8a (BioLegend, Cat# 100731) and APC anti‑mouse CD3 (BioLegend, Cat# 100235).

steps.title: Antibody staining
steps.instruction: Incubate the stained cells for 20 min at room temperature **or** 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash and final resuspension
steps.instruction: Spin the cells at 350 × g for 5 min, remove supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 400 µL PBS.

steps.title: Acquire samples on flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Run 200 µL of each sample on the flow cytometer without limiting the number of events; keep a backup half of the sample in case of clogging.

steps.title: Analyze MC38 survival
steps.instruction: Using MC38‑only control samples, gate the viable population (G0), then within G0 gate the CD3⁻/CD8⁻ double‑negative population as MC38 cells; calculate the fraction of MC38 remaining in each test sample, normalize to the corresponding negative control, and subtract from 100 % to obtain percent cytotoxicity (expect >70 % at 8:1 ratio after 16 h).

steps.title: Add peptide for positive controls
steps.instruction: For pmel‑1 CD8 cells, supplement the co‑culture at the start with hgp100 peptide at 0.96 µg/mL (1 µM); for OT‑I CD8 cells, supplement with SIINFEKL peptide at 9.63 µg/mL (10 µM).
